r1.why: Greek burnt offering, fire/massacre meanings [21]; 1950s proper noun [22]; 1970s capitalised default [25]; Shoah only Jewish victims [26]; Final Solution euphemism [27].

r2.why: Two thousand years [28]; medieval Christian antisemitism blaming Jews for Jesus [29]; political antisemitism from nationalism and industrialization, Jewish question/conspiracy [32]; races and racists [33][34].

r3.why: Party founded in wake of WWI, ideology main factor [40][36]; racial community beyond borders, purge foreign elements [42]; Lebensraum in East [43]; 1933 power [5]; emigration aim, laws, violence, Kristallnacht Nov 1938 [6].

r4.why: Ghettos after Sept 1939 invasion [7]; June 1941, 1.5-2 million [8]; Red Army POWs and men then women and children [9]; Wannsee, Heydrich, Final Solution early 1942 [10].

r5.why: Shootings and gas chambers, named camps in occupied Poland [3]; gassing on arrival, labour camp deaths and experiments [12]; Operation Reinhard [14]; most died 1942, murders until 1945 [15]; property redistributed [13].

r6.why: Millions of non-Jewish civilians and POWs killed [4]; term extended to Roma, Sinti, Soviet POWs, Polish/Soviet civilians [23]; different reasons [24].

r7.why: Survivors emigrated [16]; few trials [17]; reparations short of losses [18]; commemorated in museums, memorials, culture [19].
